title: Find Center of Star Graph
prompt: Given the edges of a star graph, return the center node.
hints: The center appears in every edge.
You only need to inspect the first two edges.

title: Find the Town Judge
prompt: Given trust relationships, return the label of the town judge if one exists, otherwise return -1.
hints: Track incoming trust and outgoing trust separately.
The judge trusts nobody and is trusted by everyone else.
